description: Size used to pick zstd compression parameters from a source size hint, a dictionary size and the parameter mode
notes: zstd 1.5.6, ZSTD_getCParamRowSize (lib/compress/zstd_compress.c). The ZSTD_cParamMode_e mode is passed as its integer value (ZSTD_cpm_attachDict = 1 ignores the dictionary); the assert(0) of the default case is a no-op in release builds; ZSTD_CONTENTSIZE_UNKNOWN is (0ULL - 1). Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: compares, two selects and a branch on 'unknown size hint and no dictionary': 14 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
